read_mac_mmio.desc: Read MAC address from MMIO NIC (e1000-style)
read_mac_mmio.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, {{BAR0}}
mov eax, [ebx + 0x5400]
ret

read_status_mmio.desc: Read link status from MMIO NIC
read_status_mmio.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, {{BAR0}}
mov eax, [ebx + 0x0008]
ret

read_rx_packets.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, {{BAR0}}
mov eax, [ebx + 0x4074]
ret

read_capacity_virtio.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, {{IOBASE}}
add dx, 0x14
in eax, dx
ret

read_status_virtio.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, {{IOBASE}}
add dx, 0x12
xor eax, eax
in al, dx
ret

read_fb_addr.desc: Read VGA framebuffer address from PCI BAR0
read_fb_addr.asm:
BITS 32
mov eax, {{BAR0}}
and eax, 0xFFFFFFF0
ret

read_vbe_version.desc: Read BochsVBE version via I/O ports
read_vbe_version.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, 0x01CE
xor eax, eax
out dx, ax
mov dx, 0x01CF
in ax, dx
movzx eax, ax
ret

read_random.desc: Read random number from VirtIO RNG
read_random.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, {{IOBASE}}
add dx, 0x12
xor eax, eax
in al, dx
ret

read_value.desc: Read sensor value from memory-mapped register

read_value_offset.desc: Read sensor value at base + offset
read_value_offset.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, {{BASE}}
mov eax, [ebx + {{OFFSET}}]
ret

write_value.asm:
BITS 32
mov dword [{{ADDR}}], {{VALUE}}
mov eax, [{{ADDR}}]
ret

read_bar0_first.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, {{BAR0}}
mov eax, [ebx]
ret

read_bar0_io.desc: Read first register at BAR0 (I/O port)
read_bar0_io.asm:
BITS 32
mov dx, {{IOBASE}}
in eax, dx
ret
